ostium_core: core logic (plain C++, no hardware)

one post per pass, QR first, taking turns
verify_, for the self-test and every scan
Assignment 1 classes, by the names in SCRUM-54:
command client = BackendClient (PollFetcher), runPoll() in poll_service.h,
readBody() in body_reader.h (size cap and time limits)
command validator = parsePollResponse() in poll_parser.h, CommandProcessor
event reporter = EventOutbox (command and QR queues), EventSender,
credential verifier = QrAccess, verifyQrToken() in qr_token.h,
verifyEd25519() in ed25519.h, runQrSelfTest() in qr_self_test.h
«utility» boxes are header files of free functions, not classes.
main.cpp creates one LockController, CommandProcessor, PollScheduler,
ServerClock, QrAccess, and ReportScheduler, two EventOutboxes (commands
and QR reports), and one of each board adapter, and wires them together.
Only the esp32s3-bench build creates a SerialScanSource.
